WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', t.created_at) AS month_start,
    t.rating,
    t.is_verified_purchase
  FROM product_reviews t
  WHERE t.is_approved = true
    AND t.created_at >= DATE '2023-01-01'
    AND t.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
  strftime(t0.month_start, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  t0.review_count AS reviews_submitted,
  t1.avg_rating,
  t2.median_rating,
  t3.pct_low_rating,
  t3.pct_high_rating,
  t3.pct_verified_purchase
FROM (
  SELECT month_start, COUNT(*) AS review_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY month_start
) t0
JOIN (
  SELECT month_start, ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating
  FROM base
  GROUP BY month_start
) t1 ON t1.month_start = t0.month_start
JOIN (
  SELECT month_start, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rating)::numeric, 1) AS median_rating
  FROM base
  GROUP BY month_start
) t2 ON t2.month_start = t0.month_start
JOIN (
  SELECT
    month_start,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rating IN (1,2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_low_rating,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rating IN (4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_high_rating,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_verified_purchase THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_verified_purchase
  FROM base
  GROUP BY month_start
) t3 ON t3.month_start = t0.month_start
ORDER BY t0.month_start ASC
note: Report is platform-wide review ratings only, at the requested grain and columns (36 monthly rows expected, 2023-01 through 2025-12). The CSAT comparison mentioned in the question isn't included as a column here since that would be a second metric/grain bundled into this report; if the analyst wants a side-by-side with support CSAT, that should be its own request (or a follow-up report joining metrics_daily/csat_responses).
